Description
 The Client is one of the majour insurance companies in the UK.
This role supports a high-priority risk reduction programme for the Green Flag MyCro Platform, a complex technology estate built on AWS. Platform SMEs have already designed remediation plans and started putting them into effect. The DevOps engineer we’re looking for will help to redesign roles and access for MyCro’s business-critical agent portal using AWS Cognito, then update a significant number of APIs to enforce the new RBAC model safely and quickly. Python skills are strongly preferred.
 Requirements
 Essential experience
Hands-on AWS Cognito configuration in production, including group- or claim-based RBAC
Securing APIs with token-based authorisation on AWS
Making access-control changes to live, business-critical systems without service disruption
 Technologies and tools
Identity: AWS Cognito (user pools, groups, app clients, OAuth 2.0 scopes, identity pools)
Standards: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT
APIs: Amazon API Gateway (REST/HTTP), Lambda authorisers
Compute: AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS
Access control: AWS IAM roles and policies
Languages: Python (boto3, pytest); Bash
Infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and/or AWS CDK, or Terraform
 Desirable
Strong Python for automation, Lambda functions and test tooling
Bulk user and permission migrations in Cognito
AWS certification (e.g. Security – Specialty)
 Job responsibilities
Implement the agreed RBAC model in AWS Cognito: user pools, groups, custom attributes and token claims
Configure identity pools and IAM role mappings where AWS resources are accessed directly
Update a large number of APIs to authorise requests against the new roles and scopes
Implement or update API Gateway authorisers (Cognito authorisers and Lambda authorisers)
Migrate existing users and permissions to the new model without locking out agents
Roll changes out safely: feature flags or staged rollout, automated authorisation tests, rollback plans
Write Python tooling and tests to validate access across the API estate
Document roles, permissions and onboarding steps for the portal
